local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local playerGui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local old = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ProtoSmasher")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "ProtoSmasher"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
if not ScreenGui.Parent then ScreenGui.Parent = playerGui end

	Red   = { bg = Color3.fromRGB(25, 10, 10),  border = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40),  accent = Color3.fromRGB(220, 50, 50)  },
	Black = { bg = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 18),  border = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 80),   accent = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120) },
	White = { bg = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40),  border = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220), accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) },
	Blue  = { bg = Color3.fromRGB(10, 15, 30),  border = Color3.fromRGB(50, 100, 200),  accent = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 230) },
}
local currentTheme = "Black"
local autoExecute = false
local rainbowConn = nil

local Main = Instance.new("Frame")
Main.Name = "Main"
Main.Parent = ScreenGui
Main.BackgroundColor3 = themes.Black.bg
Main.BorderColor3 = themes.Black.border
Main.BorderSizePixel = 2
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -225, 0.5, -200)
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 450, 0, 400)
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true
Main.ClipsDescendants = true

local TitleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TitleBar.Parent = Main
TitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
TitleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
TitleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 26)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Parent = TitleBar
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 1, 0)
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
Title.Text = "ProtoSmasher v2"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
Title.TextSize = 14
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local MinBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinBtn.Parent = TitleBar
MinBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
MinBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 0)
MinBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
MinBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
MinBtn.Text = "—"
MinBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
MinBtn.TextSize = 14

local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Parent = TitleBar
CloseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0)
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 1, 0)
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
CloseBtn.Text = "×"
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
CloseBtn.TextSize = 16

local Editor = Instance.new("Frame")
Editor.Parent = Main
Editor.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
Editor.BorderSizePixel = 0
Editor.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 30)
Editor.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 245)

local LineNum = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LineNum.Parent = Editor
LineNum.BackgroundTransparency = 1
LineNum.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 4)
LineNum.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -8)
LineNum.Font = Enum.Font.Code
LineNum.Text = "1"
LineNum.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
LineNum.TextSize = 13
LineNum.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top

local TextBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
TextBox.Parent = Editor
TextBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 4)
TextBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 1, -8)
TextBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
TextBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
TextBox.MultiLine = true
TextBox.Text = ""
TextBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
TextBox.TextSize = 13
TextBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TextBox.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
TextBox.TextWrapped = false

TextBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	local lines = 1
	for _ in TextBox.Text:gmatch("\n") do lines = lines + 1 end
	local s = ""
	for i = 1, math.max(lines, 1) do s = s .. i .. "\n" end
	LineNum.Text = s
end)

local BtnBar = Instance.new("Frame")
BtnBar.Parent = Main
BtnBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
BtnBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 283)
BtnBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 36)

local function makeBtn(name, x)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Parent = BtnBar
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	b.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	b.BorderSizePixel = 1
	b.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 2)
	b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 32)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
	b.Text = name
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
	b.TextSize = 14
	return b
end

local ExecBtn   = makeBtn("EXECUTE", 8)
local OpenBtn   = makeBtn("OPEN", 118)
local ClearBtn  = makeBtn("CLEAR", 228)
local InjectBtn = makeBtn("INJECT", 338)

local BottomArea = Instance.new("Frame")
BottomArea.Parent = Main
BottomArea.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 55)
BottomArea.BorderSizePixel = 0
BottomArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 328)
BottomArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 72)

local ThemeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ThemeBtn.Parent = BottomArea
ThemeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
ThemeBtn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
ThemeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 1
ThemeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -28)
ThemeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 22)
ThemeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
ThemeBtn.Text = "  Theme: Black  ▼"
ThemeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
ThemeBtn.TextSize = 13
ThemeBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

local ColorMenu = Instance.new("Frame")
ColorMenu.Parent = Main
ColorMenu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
ColorMenu.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
ColorMenu.BorderSizePixel = 1
ColorMenu.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -150)
ColorMenu.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 120)
ColorMenu.Visible = false
ColorMenu.ZIndex = 10

local function colorOption(name, y)
	local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
	b.Parent = ColorMenu
	b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
	b.BorderSizePixel = 0
	b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y)
	b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
	b.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	b.Text = "  " .. name
	b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	b.TextSize = 13
	b.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	b.ZIndex = 11
	return b
end

local RedOpt      = colorOption("Red", 0)
local BlackOpt    = colorOption("Black", 24)
local WhiteOpt    = colorOption("White", 48)
local BlueOpt     = colorOption("Blue", 72)
local RainbowOpt  = colorOption("Rainbow", 96)

local SettingsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
SettingsBtn.Parent = BottomArea
SettingsBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
SettingsBtn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
SettingsBtn.BorderSizePixel = 1
SettingsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 230, 1, -30)
SettingsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 24)
SettingsBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
SettingsBtn.Text = "Settings"
SettingsBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
SettingsBtn.TextSize = 13

local function stopRainbow()
	if rainbowConn then
		rainbowConn:Disconnect()
		rainbowConn = nil
	end
end

local function applyTheme(name)
	stopRainbow()
	if name == "Rainbow" then
		currentTheme = "Rainbow"
		ThemeBtn.Text = "  Theme: Rainbow  ▼"
		ColorMenu.Visible = false
		local hue = 0
		rainbowConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
			hue = (hue + dt * 0.15) % 1
			local c = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.7, 0.9)
			Main.BorderColor3 = c
			for _, btn in ipairs({ExecBtn, OpenBtn, ClearBtn, InjectBtn}) do
				btn.BorderColor3 = c
			end
		end)
		print("[ProtoSmasher]: Theme → Rainbow")
		return
	end

	local t = themes[name]
	if not t then return end
	currentTheme = name
	Main.BackgroundColor3 = t.bg
	Main.BorderColor3 = t.border
	TitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
		math.clamp(t.bg.R * 255 + 12, 0, 255) / 255,
		math.clamp(t.bg.G * 255 + 12, 0, 255) / 255,
		math.clamp(t.bg.B * 255 + 12, 0, 255) / 255
	)
	for _, btn in ipairs({ExecBtn, OpenBtn, ClearBtn, InjectBtn}) do
		btn.BorderColor3 = t.accent
	end
	ThemeBtn.Text = "  Theme: " .. name .. "  ▼"
	ColorMenu.Visible = false
	print("[ProtoSmasher]: Theme → " .. name)
end

ThemeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ColorMenu.Visible = not ColorMenu.Visible
end)

RedOpt.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() applyTheme("Red") end)
BlackOpt.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() applyTheme("Black") end)
WhiteOpt.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() applyTheme("White") end)
BlueOpt.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() applyTheme("Blue") end)
RainbowOpt.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() applyTheme("Rainbow") end)

local function runCode()
	local code = TextBox.Text
	if code == "" or code:match("^%s*$") then return end
	local chunk, err = loadstring(code)
	if chunk then
		local ok, msg = pcall(chunk)
		if not ok then warn("[ProtoSmasher]: " .. tostring(msg)) end
	else
		warn("[ProtoSmasher]: " .. tostring(err))
	end
end

ExecBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(runCode)
InjectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(runCode)
ClearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() TextBox.Text = "" end)
OpenBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() print("[ProtoSmasher]: Open") end)

-- Settings (tylko Auto Execute)
local settingsWin = nil

local function closeSettings()
	if settingsWin then settingsWin:Destroy() settingsWin = nil end
end

local function openSettings()
	if settingsWin then closeSettings() return end

	local win = Instance.new("Frame")
	win.Name = "SettingsWin"
	win.Parent = ScreenGui
	win.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
	win.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
	win.BorderSizePixel = 2
	win.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.5, -60)
	win.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 100)
	win.Active = true
	win.Draggable = true
	win.ZIndex = 30
	settingsWin = win

	local stBar = Instance.new("Frame")
	stBar.Parent = win
	stBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	stBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	stBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
	stBar.ZIndex = 31

	local stTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	stTitle.Parent = stBar
	stTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	stTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	stTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 1, 0)
	stTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	stTitle.Text = "Settings"
	stTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	stTitle.TextSize = 13
	stTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	stTitle.ZIndex = 32

	local stClose = Instance.new("TextButton")
	stClose.Parent = stBar
	stClose.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	stClose.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 0)
	stClose.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 1, 0)
	stClose.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	stClose.Text = "×"
	stClose.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
	stClose.TextSize = 14
	stClose.ZIndex = 32
	stClose.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeSettings)

	local autoRow = Instance.new("Frame")
	autoRow.Parent = win
	autoRow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 45)
	autoRow.BorderSizePixel = 0
	autoRow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 36)
	autoRow.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 36)
	autoRow.ZIndex = 31

	local autoLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	autoLbl.Parent = autoRow
	autoLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	autoLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
	autoLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
	autoLbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	autoLbl.Text = "Auto Execute"
	autoLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 220)
	autoLbl.TextSize = 13
	autoLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	autoLbl.ZIndex = 32

	local autoToggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
	autoToggle.Parent = autoRow
	autoToggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
	autoToggle.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -14)
	autoToggle.BackgroundColor3 = autoExecute and Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 60) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
	autoToggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
	autoToggle.Text = ""
	autoToggle.ZIndex = 32

	autoToggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		autoExecute = not autoExecute
		if autoExecute then
			autoToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 180, 60)
			runCode()
			print("[ProtoSmasher]: Auto Execute ON")
		else
			autoToggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 40, 40)
			print("[ProtoSmasher]: Auto Execute OFF")
		end
	end)
end

SettingsBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(openSettings)

MinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	Main.Visible = not Main.Visible
end)

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	stopRainbow()
	closeSettings()
	ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

print("[ProtoSmasher v2]: Loaded")

scripts.features:
🎮 Minigame Hub: 22 playable minigames in one draggable, mobile-friendly UI
## Hub features
- **Draggable** by the title bar, clamped to the screen
- **Minimise** to a small pill, **close** to destroy everything and clean up connections
- **Games pause** while the window is minimised
- **Mobile friendly:** scales to the screen, with tap, swipe and on-screen d-pad controls
- **Back button** and a scrollable game menu
- **Session best scores** for every game
- **Pure Luau and UI:** no models, images or sounds, and no server code

## Game list

### Arcade and reflex
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Tap Rush** | Tap as many times as you can in 10 seconds. Shows taps per second and your best. |
| 4 | **Snake** | 14×14 grid that speeds up as you eat. Controls: d-pad, swipe, arrow keys or WASD. |
| 6 | **Reaction Test** | Tap when the screen turns green. Tapping early fails the round. Scored in milliseconds. |
| 7 | **Whack-a-Mole** | 3×3 holes over 20 seconds. Moles appear faster and vanish sooner as time runs down. |
| 10 | **Flappy Block** | Tap or press Space to flap through pipes. Gravity and collisions run on Heartbeat. |

### Memory and puzzle
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | **Memory Match** | 4×4 card flip with 8 pairs. Fewer moves is a better score. |
| 8 | **Simon Says** | Repeat a growing colour sequence. |
| 14 | **Lights Out** | 5×5 puzzle where tapping a light toggles its neighbours. Puzzles are always solvable. |
| 17 | **2048** | Swipe, d-pad or keys. Tiles merge once per move, and you can keep playing past 2048. |
| 18 | **Minesweeper** | 9×9 with 8, 12 or 16 mines. Dig/Flag toggle, first tap always safe, chording, and a timer. |
| 20 | **Sudoku** | Every puzzle has exactly one solution. Easy, Medium and Hard (40, 33 and 27 clues), with hints, reset, timer and highlighting. |

### Quick-think and word
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | **Number Guess** | Guess 1–100 in 8 tries, with a narrowing range hint. |
| 11 | **Math Dash** | 30 seconds of add, subtract and multiply. A wrong answer costs 2 seconds. |
| 12 | **Higher or Lower** | Card streak game. Equal cards are a push. |
| 13 | **Color Clash** | Stroop test where you tap the ink colour, not the word. 25 seconds, and a wrong answer costs 2 seconds. |
| 21 | **Hangman** | 4 categories with 14 words each, a drawn gallows and a keyboard. Has two rare boss words (see below). |

### Versus AI
| # | Game | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | **Tic Tac Toe** | Minimax AI that makes the occasional mistake so it can be beaten. The starting player alternates. |
| 9 | **RPS Battle** | Rock, paper, scissors with a win/loss/draw tally. |
| 15 | **UNO** | Full 108-card deck, wild colour picker, UNO call and catch rules. Choose a **Bot IQ** (see below). |
| 16 | **Connect 4** | Minimax with alpha-beta pruning at 3 difficulties. |
| 19 | **Checkers** | American rules: forced captures, multi-jumps, kings. Minimax AI at 3 depths, with a 50-move draw rule. |
| 22 | **Battleship** | 8×8 board and a fleet of 5, 4, 3, 3 and 2. Shuffle your ships, 3 bot levels. |

## AI details

**UNO Bot IQ**
- **Easy:** random legal plays and random colour picks. It sometimes forgets to call UNO, and you can catch it.
- **Medium:** saves wilds, prefers action cards, keeps its longest colour.
- **Hard:** counts unseen cards, remembers which colours you couldn't answer, and saves +4 for when you're close to winning.

        if not camera then return end

        local direction = Vector3.zero
        local move = humanoid.MoveDirection
        local look = camera.CFrame.LookVector
        local right = camera.CFrame.RightVector

        local flatLook = Vector3.new(look.X, 0, look.Z)
        local flatRight = Vector3.new(right.X, 0, right.Z)

        if flatLook.Magnitude > 0 then
            flatLook = flatLook.Unit
        end

        if flatRight.Magnitude > 0 then
            flatRight = flatRight.Unit
        end

        if move.Magnitude > 0 then
            local forwardAmount = move:Dot(flatLook)
            local rightAmount = move:Dot(flatRight)
            direction = look * forwardAmount + flatRight * rightAmount
        end

        if not UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then direction -= right end

            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then direction += Vector3.yAxis end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then direction -= Vector3.yAxis end
        end

        if direction.Magnitude > 0 then

        bv.Velocity = direction

    end)

local function MakeDraggable(topbarobject, object)
	local Dragging = nil
	local DragInput = nil
	local DragStart = nil
	local StartPosition = nil

	local function Update(input)
		local Delta = input.Position - DragStart
		local pos =
			UDim2.new(
				StartPosition.X.Scale,
				StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
				StartPosition.Y.Scale,
				StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
			)
		object.Position = pos
	end

	topbarobject.InputBegan:Connect(
		function(input)
			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				Dragging = true
				DragStart = input.Position
				StartPosition = object.Position

				input.Changed:Connect(
					function()
						if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
							Dragging = false
						end
					end
				)
			end
		end
	)

	topbarobject.InputChanged:Connect(
		function(input)
			if
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or
				input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				DragInput = input
			end
		end

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
env.__ChatBlocker = env.__ChatBlocker or { enabled = false, hooked = false }
local State = env.__ChatBlocker

if State.unload then
    pcall(State.unload)
end

local function isLegacyChatRemote(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance"
        and inst.ClassName == "RemoteEvent"
        and inst.Name == "SayMessageRequest"
end

local function isTextChannel(inst)
    return typeof(inst) == "Instance" and inst.ClassName == "TextChannel"
end

if not State.hooked then
    State.hooked = true

    if hookmetamethod and getnamecallmethod then
        local oldNamecall
        oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
            if State.enabled then
                local method = getnamecallmethod()
                if method == "FireServer" and isLegacyChatRemote(self) then
                    return
                end
                if method == "SendAsync" and isTextChannel(self) then
                    return
                end
            end
            return oldNamecall(self, ...)
        end))
    else
        warn("[ChatBlocker] executor has no hookmetamethod, namecall hook will not be installed")
    end

    if hookfunction then
        local function hookMethod(className, methodName, check)
            pcall(function()
                local dummy = Instance.new(className)
                local orig
                orig = hookfunction(dummy[methodName], newcclosure(function(self, ...)
                    if State.enabled and check(self) then
                        return
                    end
                    return orig(self, ...)
                end))
                dummy:Destroy()
            end)
        end

        hookMethod("RemoteEvent", "FireServer", isLegacyChatRemote)
        hookMethod("TextChannel", "SendAsync", isTextChannel)
    end
end

local function setInputBar(blocked)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration")
        if not cfg then
            return
        end
        if blocked then
            if State.prevBar == nil then
                State.prevBar = cfg.Enabled
            end
            cfg.Enabled = false
        elseif State.prevBar ~= nil then
            cfg.Enabled = State.prevBar
            State.prevBar = nil
        end
    end)
end

local function getGuiParent()
    if gethui then
        local ok, ui = pcall(gethui)
        if ok and ui then
            return ui
        end
    end
    if pcall(function() return CoreGui:GetChildren() end) then
        return CoreGui
    end
    return Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "ChatBlockerGui"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    pcall(syn.protect_gui, gui)
end
gui.Parent = getGuiParent()

title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", title).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

closeBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0)
closeBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 90, 90)
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 18
closeBtn.Parent = title

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Name = "Toggle"
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 40)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 42)
toggle.BorderSizePixel = 0
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
toggle.TextSize = 20
toggle.AutoButtonColor = true
toggle.Parent = frame
Instance.new("UICorner", toggle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local hint = Instance.new("TextLabel")
hint.Name = "Hint"
hint.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 18)

hint.Text = "RShift - hide / show"
hint.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 140)
hint.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
hint.TextSize = 14
hint.Parent = frame

local function refresh()
    if State.enabled then
        toggle.Text = "Chat: BLOCKED"
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 90)
    else
        toggle.Text = "Chat: ALLOWED"
        toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 55, 55)
    end
end

local function setBlocked(value)
    State.enabled = value
    setInputBar(value)
    refresh()
end

local conns = {}
local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    table.insert(conns, c)
    return c
end

local dragging, dragStart, startPos, dragInput

connect(title.InputBegan, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

connect(title.InputChanged, function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

connect(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
    if dragging and input == dragInput then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

local function unload()
    State.enabled = false
    setInputBar(false)
    for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
        pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    if gui then
        gui:Destroy()
    end
    State.unload = nil
end
State.unload = unload

connect(toggle.MouseButton1Click, function()
    setBlocked(not State.enabled)
end)

connect(closeBtn.MouseButton1Click, unload)

connect(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then
        return
    end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        frame.Visible = not frame.Visible
    end
end)
